div.div:
Notes
*1 The agent decides when to run; the state machine owns the order of
the steps
The agent decides only the operation to start and its input; the state
machine guarantees the order and branching of the steps
*2 The pinned state machine cannot be swapped
The pinned state machine ARN never appears in the tool arguments, so
no other state machine can be started
